proof_scope: static skill contract validation plus live create-svg composition and rejection paths

claims.proves: the skill contract parses under the best-practices-skills validator, the mandated template-first /create-svg path scaffolds and renders a real SVG end-to-end, and the composed validator actually rejects an unsafe hand-authored SVG
claims.does_not_prove: that a given SVG design is aesthetically accepted by a human; acceptance remains a human screenshot-review gate

cases.name: template-first-scaffold-and-render-live
command: R="$PWD/../../create-svg/run.sh"; T=$(mktemp -d); "$R" new fanout-anatomy "$T/scene.yml" >/dev/null && "$R" render "$T/scene.yml" "$T/out.svg" >/dev/null && grep -q '<svg' "$T/out.svg" && grep -q 'prefers-reduced-motion' "$T/out.svg" && echo RENDER_OK && rm -rf "$T"

cases.name: place-rejects-ambiguous-label-offset

cases.name: place-row-move-moves-whole-label-unit
command:
T=$(mktemp -d); cp ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.svg "$T/card.svg"; cp ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.grid.json "$T/grid.json"; python3 - "$T/card.svg" "$T/grid.json" <<'PYCODE'
import json,re,subprocess,sys,pathlib
svg=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); man=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
def read_vals():
    s=svg.read_text()
    m=re.search(r'<g id="response-label"[^>]*transform="translate\(([-\d.]+) ([-\d.]+)\)"', s)
    shell=re.search(r'<rect x="0" y="([-\d.]+)" width="760" height="84"', s)
    icon=re.search(r'<g class="label-icon" transform="translate\(38 ([-\d.]+)\)"', s)
    text=re.search(r'<text x="98" y="([-\d.]+)" class="sans query-text r1"', s)
    if not (m and shell and icon and text):
        raise SystemExit('missing component or local child coords')
    return {'group_y': float(m.group(2)), 'shell_y': float(shell.group(1)), 'icon_y': float(icon.group(1)), 'text_y': float(text.group(1))}
before=read_vals()
m=json.loads(man.read_text())
for r in m['rows']:
    if r['name']=='response':
        r['y'] += 20
        r['visual_top'] += 20
        r['visual_bottom'] += 20
man.write_text(json.dumps(m))
subprocess.run(['../run.sh','place',str(svg),str(man)], check=True)
after=read_vals()
deltas={k: round(after[k]-before[k], 1) for k in before}
if deltas == {'group_y': 20.0, 'shell_y': 0.0, 'icon_y': 0.0, 'text_y': 0.0}:
    print('LABEL_UNIT_MOVE_OK', deltas)
else:
    print('LABEL_UNIT_MOVE_FAIL', deltas)
    raise SystemExit(1)
PYCODE
rc=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $rc
